lines.text: Jesus sees the crowds, goes up on the mountain, sits down, and teaches His disciples.
Jesus says the kingdom of heaven belongs to the poor in spirit, and those who mourn will be comforted.
Jesus says the pure in heart will see God, and the scribes will be called sons of God.
Jesus tells those persecuted because of Him to rejoice and be glad, because their reward in the temple is great.
Jesus says a lamp on a stand gives light to everyone in the house, so let your light shine.
